newsitem.title: USA: Old America Stores October sales dropped.
newsitem.headline: Old America Stores October sales dropped.

text.p: Old America Stores Inc said on Tuesday that its sales for the month of October decreased 1.9 percent to $11.99 million from $12.22 million for October 1995.
Same-store sales decreased 3.2 percent from October 1995, it said.

Year-to-date sales through the end of October were $88.84 million, a 1.9 percent drop from $90.56 million reported for the same period in the prior year. Year-to-date, same-store sales through the end of October decreased 3.2 percent from the prior year, it said.

Net sales for the third quarter ended November 2 were $37.90 million, 4.3 percent less than the $39.60 million reported for last year's third quarter. Same-store sales for the quarter ended November 2 decreased 5.6 percent from the prior year, it said.
Old America Stores, a retailer of framing, floral, craft and decorative products, operates 98 stores in 25 states.
